'''Assimilated Cows''' are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Cows.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Cow succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 4 Cows have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by [[Adapted Summoner|Adapted Summoners]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Cows are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Assimilated Cows are capable of performing a charge attack. After staying still for some seconds, they'll move forward. This Attack inflicts great knockback and AoE Damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Cow will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Cows are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Cows are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Cow gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding Assimilated Ender Dragon and Assimilated Big Spider.</ref>, it will evolve into Moving Flesh.
* If an Assimilated Cow gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into Moving Flesh, it will evolve into a [[Feral Cow]].
* On death Assimilated Cows have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 3-4 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Cow will drop its [[Walking Cow Head|Head]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Assimilated Cows, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
